facts.fact: The Ministry of Justice launched the e-RCCM platform (e-actes-rccm.gov.bf) on 15 December 2025, letting users obtain RCCM registration attestations, non-bankruptcy attestations and register extracts online.
facts.system: e-RCCM (Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier)
